title: Release Checklist
description: Pre-release, release, and post-release checks for safe production deployments.

entries.content: Announce freeze window in team channel and update project board.
Verify test, lint, and build checks are passing on release commit.
Summarize user-facing changes, breaking changes, and migration steps.
Tag semver release and publish the changelog entry.
Run deployment workflow and monitor rollout progress.
Validate login, core API endpoints, and primary user journey.
Watch metrics for at least 30 minutes and compare against baseline.
Post release summary with version and key changes to stakeholders.
